name: app-correctness
brief: Close six user-visible correctness gaps in DungeonMaster.App, all re-measured live at base 18329d4. A1: DungeonDetailViewModel.LoadDungeonAsync treats a well-formed Guid that names no dungeon as loaded; it must report a NotFound error through ResultMessage and clear the dungeon id so every editing command's NoDungeonIsLoaded gate refuses saves. A2: CreateDungeonViewModel never clears ErrorMessage; reset it when a create starts. A3: both StartSession buttons (DungeonListPage, inside DmCard, and DungeonDetailPage) are enabled on a floored dungeon and do nothing; disable them, keeping tooltips and comments true. A4: the Ctrl+Up/Down floor reorder chord uses HasFlag(Control); require exactly Control, with Ctrl+0 offered as an optional add. A5: ApplyZoom passes a non-finite zoom through Math.Clamp; reject non-finite input and leave zoom unchanged, testable on Windows through an extracted helper. A6: fold the Detach/AttachScrollZoom calls in OnMapCanvasHandlerChanged into its try. Every guard gets a test proven to fail on an injected revert, with a passing control. Optional add: the mixed-indent line, now at DungeonDetailPage.xaml.cs:616.
